title: Imports and exports
description: Where imports go, what to export and how modules depend on each other.

rules.title: Imports at the top
rules.text: Put all imports at the top of the file. Use a local import only for a real circular dependency or an optional lazy load.

rules.title: No wildcard imports
rules.text: Avoid wildcard imports. Import the names you use.

rules.title: Named exports
rules.text: Prefer named exports. Use default exports only where a framework requires them.

rules.title: Few barrel files
rules.text: Avoid barrel files and re-exports between modules, except at the public entry point of a package.

rules.title: No import cycles
rules.text: Do not introduce import cycles. Move shared code to a lower layer instead.

rules.title: Enforce layering
rules.text: Enforce import direction between layers with a lint rule or dependency checker and fix violations instead of bypassing them.

rules.title: Consistent extensions
rules.text: Follow the project rule on file extensions in relative imports and keep it consistent.

rules.title: Formatter sorts imports
rules.text: Let the formatter order imports. Do not reorder lines you did not change.

rules.title: Private by default
rules.text: Keep symbols private by default and widen visibility only when another module needs them.
